# Tables of control metadata

This section contains tables that show the metadata for controls, including the
**Framework** supported, the **Control objective**,
and **Regional control identifiers**. Remember that older controls have a
unique API identifier for each Region in which AWS Control Tower is available. Each control also has
a [global
identifier](all-global-identifiers.md "all-global-identifiers.md").

When you are working with the control APIs, you can provide the identifier for the Region
in which you are making the API call, or the global identifier. We recommend that you
provide the global identifier in most cases. To view global identifiers, see [All global
identifiers for AWS Control Tower controls](all-global-identifiers.md "all-global-identifiers.md").

###### Note

If the table shows **N/A** next to the **Region**
name, the control does not have a regional identifier, only a global identifier. To view
global identifiers, see [All global
identifiers for AWS Control Tower controls](all-global-identifiers.md "all-global-identifiers.md").

Last updated May 6, 2025
